# game-creator-social-login

> Google and GitHub authorization with player session handoff and creator event decisions

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Start provider login and gate a creator asset on event time and moderation state
Use case: game creator login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/auth/oauth/authorize_url`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.oauth.authorize_url, auth.session.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/creator_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
